Fixes: (1) argv spelled --policy-window-cycles -> the real CLI flag --policy-window; (2) reverse A-order readback raw 0xF10 bit0 validated for both roles; (3) the selection technical gate now requires the complete current CLI record (success/validated true, syscall_rc/errno 0, status 0, stage 5, flush_status acceptable, raw_captured 4096, observer_magic, empty errors, exact echoed input envelope, argv, capability F00..F03, reverse F10, uniform policy block, config readback and p4m window) instead of silently defaulting absent keys; a record missing any of them never enters the winner selection, and the unmatched fallback also requires a technically valid record; all candidate outcomes/reasons are persisted; (4) the analyzer reuses the legacy check_envelope/analyze_e2/analyze_cost/validate_fullstats through an adapted case view, with the legacy analyzer being a hard-required dependency and exceptions surfaced as errors, preserving the E2 target replacement/first-miss lifecycle evidence; (5) E2 timing D8B/D8C/D8D identity and D8E/D8F reserved words validated; (6) the E20..0xE5F policy map is validated (v_done_bytes, short/full windows, dup miss alias, hit+miss<=lookup, issue>=done, b_min<=b_max, boundaries, histogram sum) and exposed as billing-window vs common-V-window metrics with permission_closed_cycles explicitly not called an actual stall; (7) the formal comparison now re-derives the pre-registered matching rule from the formal runs themselves (paired V median within 5%, both sides reaching the target, per-run E23/E20 deficit fraction difference <= 0.10, all paired runs with E20>0), reports all paired A differences with descriptive bootstrap CIs and the 5% engineering threshold, refuses any gain claim when protection is unmatched or pairing is missing, compares p5 against every other method as well as the fixed-gap control, keeps a_pages/reverse in the pairing key so A1/A16 boundary data never overwrite each other, never uses holdout for selection, and fails closed on malformed records and explicit stopped cases. Plan/module APIs build_plan/select_configs/resolve_case/metrics/validate_record keep their signatures.

def _policy_counters(raw):
    """E20..0xE3F policy counters plus the E40..0xE5F V-done histogram.

    ``final_balance_signed`` is exposed both as the raw 64-bit word and as a
    two's-complement signed value; no other counter is reinterpreted.  The
    billing window (policy config readback 0xE06) and the V common hardware
    window (0xC19) are reported separately and never used as each other's
    denominator.
    """
    counters = {name: raw[address] for name, address in POLICY_COUNTER_REGS}
    histogram = [raw[POLICY_HISTOGRAM_BASE + bucket]
                 for bucket in range(POLICY_HISTOGRAM_BUCKETS)]
    balance = counters["final_balance_signed"]
    if balance >= 1 << 63:
        balance -= 1 << 64
    return {
        "counters": counters,
        "histogram": histogram,
        "histogram_sum": sum(histogram),
        "final_balance_signed": balance,
        "reserved_word": raw[POLICY_RESERVED_WORD],
        "permission_closed_note": (
            "0xE25 is permission_closed_cycles; there is no frontend wait input, "
            "so it is never an actual ADMIT-blocked or stall period"
        ),
    }

    corrupt fullstats block fails the case instead of being skipped.

    if case.get("role") == 1:

def _median(values):

    return statistics.median(values)


def _metric_value(item, field):
    metrics = item.get("metrics") or {}

    return value if isinstance(value, (int, float)) else None


def _policy_value(item, field):
    metrics = item.get("metrics") or {}
    policy = metrics.get("policy") or {}
    counters = policy.get("counters") or {}
    value = counters.get(field)
    return value if isinstance(value, int) else None


def _deficit_fraction(item):
    windows = _policy_value(item, "complete_active_windows")
    short = _policy_value(item, "short_windows")
    if windows is None or short is None or windows <= 0:
        return None
    return short / float(windows)

def _compare_pair(by_key, group_key, method, baseline, target, a_pages, reverse,
                  selection):
    pairs = []
    for block in sorted({key[2] for key in by_key if key[1] == target}):
        left = by_key.get((method, target, block, a_pages, reverse))
        right = by_key.get((baseline, target, block, a_pages, reverse))
        if left is None or right is None:
            continue
        left_a = _metric_value(left, "a_mib_s")
        right_a = _metric_value(right, "a_mib_s")
        if left_a is None or right_a is None:
            continue
        pairs.append((left, right, left_a, right_a))
    present = any(key[0] == method and key[1] == target and key[3] == a_pages
                  and key[4] == reverse for key in by_key)
    if not present:
        return None

    differences = [left_a - right_a for _, _, left_a, right_a in pairs]
    left_v = [v for v in (_metric_value(left, "v_mib_s") for left, _, _, _ in pairs)
              if v is not None]
    right_v = [v for v in (_metric_value(right, "v_mib_s") for _, right, _, _ in pairs)
               if v is not None]
    left_deficit = [d for d in (_deficit_fraction(left) for left, _, _, _ in pairs)
                    if d is not None]
    right_deficit = [d for d in (_deficit_fraction(right) for _, right, _, _ in pairs)
                     if d is not None]
    left_windows = [_policy_value(left, "complete_active_windows") for left, _, _, _ in pairs]
    right_windows = [_policy_value(right, "complete_active_windows") for _, right, _, _ in pairs]
    left_a_values = [left_a for _, _, left_a, _ in pairs]
    right_a_values = [right_a for _, _, _, right_a in pairs]

    left_v_median = _median(left_v)
    right_v_median = _median(right_v)
    left_deficit_mean = statistics.mean(left_deficit) if left_deficit else None
    right_deficit_mean = statistics.mean(right_deficit) if right_deficit else None

    full_windows_ok = bool(pairs) and all(
        value is not None and value > 0 for value in left_windows + right_windows)
    v_relative_diff = None
    if (left_v_median is not None and right_v_median is not None and
            (left_v_median + right_v_median) > 0):
        v_relative_diff = (abs(left_v_median - right_v_median) /
                           ((left_v_median + right_v_median) / 2.0))
    deficit_diff = None

    target_met_right = right_v_median is not None and right_v_median >= target
    v_match = v_relative_diff is not None and v_relative_diff <= MATCH_V_TOLERANCE
    deficit_match = (deficit_diff is not None and
                     deficit_diff <= MATCH_DEFICIT_TOLERANCE)
    protection_matched = bool(
        pairs and full_windows_ok and v_match and deficit_match
        and target_met_left and target_met_right)
